title: Hanasato Minori — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days before Minori's birthday
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here we aaare!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, this really takes me back to when I shadowed as a zookeeper here with Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so happy I get to celebrate my birthday here! Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't mention it. We wanted to come here too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and not to mention the stream—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ack! Uh...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: C'mon, Shizuku. Let's enjoy our day off and not talk about work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You're right, I'm sorry. I must have work on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, Minori, did you bring something proving your date of birth?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They won't let you get the birthday package without that. Did you remember?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I've got my student ID with me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, perfect. Well then, let's enjoy today to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Here's your Happy Petter Ticket, available only to guests who visit us on their birthday.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Present this ticket at any of the spots marked with hearts on the map, and you'll be able to pet and feed our animals there. Enjoy, Ms. Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Thank you, Mr. Nakazawa!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
It's no trouble at all.
It's our pleasure to have you back here again. Have a pleasant visit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, where to start?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
I'm way ahead of you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like someone came well-prepared.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, I was so excited yesterday that I did a ton of research...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...so, in conclusion! I want to start with the Fluffy Fluff Petting Zoo over there!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Look at all these chicks. Hehe, they're so cute—
Wah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...! They're all crowding up to Haruka's hands...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehehe. Their little beaks are tickling me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Wh-What do I do, Airi? Haruka and the chicks are both so cute, I can't stop taking pictures!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Relax, you can take as many photos as you like today. Let's move once Haruka's done.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww! The chipmunks are so fuzzy and cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Miku and Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehehe. You said you were gonna go to the zoo, so we thought we'd drop by♪ Ooh, are those chipmunks?!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They are! Wanna take a closer look?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes please! Wow, look how their cheeks are bulging! Hehe, I guess they like their food.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And last but absolutely not least, this feathered friend!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I missed you, Schubert!
I'm gonna feed you now, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh... Are you sure you're gonna be okay? What if he bites your fingers off...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, don't worry about it. Minori and Schubert are birds of a feather.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yikes, what was that?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm, I remember the zookeeper here saying that shoebills clatter their beaks like that to display affection.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See, Schubert's bowing back to her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, how adorable.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it looks like he's enjoying his meal. He must be glad to be reunited with Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Schubeeert!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess Minori's enough of a wild animal herself to be at home here. I had nothing to worry about.
Odaiba Animal Land - Cafe

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, we got to see a whole ton of stuff, so let's take a break and then head home.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! Let's see, what to order...

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting. Here's your cake made with seasonal fruits.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Um... But we didn't order yet...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's a few days early, but...
Happy birthday, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, did you get me a cake?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. We reserved it in advance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for helping make this happen.

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
It was nothing...
Um... Happy birthday, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: I, um... I'm actually a fan of yours...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You guys got one of my fans to pretend to be a waiter here?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What kind of masterminds do you think we are?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's such a coincidence. To think we'd run into one of your fans right when we're doing this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... Um!
Thank you for your constant support!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: N-No, I need to be thanking you, Minori! You help me give it my all every day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Hearing that from you is gonna help me do more and more too!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad to hear it! You're doing a stream on your birthday, right? I'm really looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! I promise to make it a really entertaining one, so you won't be disappointed!
